summary: ERROR TO THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE DISTRICT OF MINNESOTA.
attorneys: Mr. E. C. Palmer for plaintiff in error., Mr. John C. Spooner, Mr. B. J. Stevens, Mr. P. L. Spooner and Mr. J. C. Sloan for defendant in error.

opinions.author: Field
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Field

delivered the opinion of the court.

This case depends upon the same principles for its disposition as the case of Schulenberg v. Harriman, just decided, 21 Wall. 44, and upon its authority the judgment is Affirmed.
